npcs.name: Herder-Chief Maelan
npcs.idle: Brynach's been a herders' town since before there were kings. We know the host rides. We just keep the cows in.

npcs.name: Roadwarden Fiona
npcs.idle: The road from Lough Derg to Druim Cain is mine to keep. Lately it's keeping me.

npcs.name: Nessa the Weaver
npcs.idle: Aideen's sixteen and dreams of a golden hall every night. I wish she'd dream of weaving.

npcs.name: Aideen
npcs.idle: Do you ever dream of a place so clearly you could find your way round it awake?

npcs.name: Sarnat of Caille
npcs.idle: Caille has kept the bargain with the hill for a thousand years. We don't break it. We don't let it be broken.

npcs.name: Ranger-Commander Fearghal
npcs.idle: Druim Cain holds the frontier. The Rangers hold everything between it and Lough Derg. Mostly.

npcs.name: Grandmother Muirenn
npcs.idle: Rian went through the veil at Samhain. He was ten. He's still ten, there.

npcs.name: Druid Ennis
npcs.idle: The grove's oaks are dying. Their heart was stolen.

npcs.name: Brogan the Miner
npcs.idle: Forty years I dug that mine. Forty days the siog have had it. They don't even dig properly.

npcs.name: Herder Tuathal
npcs.idle: Don't graze the south pasture after dusk. That's not a rule. That's advice from a man with nine fewer cows.

npcs.name: Fisher Caoimhe
npcs.idle: The fish in Moon Lake come up to look at the moon. So do other things.

npcs.name: Watch-Sergeant Maudalin
npcs.idle: Giolladhe's Tower watches the west road. The west road watches back.

npcs.name: Keeper Rasa
npcs.idle: I kept the empyreans for forty years. They were the sky's own children. Then the wind changed.

npcs.name: Ranger-Scout Fionnuala
npcs.idle: Past those stones is the Cursed Forest. I've been in. Once. I don't talk about it.

quests.title: The Road to Caille
quests.offer:
New to Brynach? Welcome. We're herders - cows, sheep, the odd fairy horse when it wanders in.

Caille, up the road north-east, is where the valley's business gets done. Will you [take the wool] to Sarnat there? She'll pay you, and she'll tell you what's what in Bri Leith. Keep to the road. If you hear hooves after dark, get off it.
quests.summary: Herder-Chief Maelan in Brynach has wool for Sarnat in Caille, up the road.

steps.goal: Take Maelan's wool to Sarnat of Caille, about 420 m north-east of Brynach up the road
steps.say:
Brynach wool! Maelan's the only one who still sends it carded.

You walked up from Brynach? Then you've seen the valley's easy half. Look around Caille - and out in the valley. There's work everywhere, and most of it has hooves or wings.

quests.title: Brogan's Tools
quests.offer:
The siog took our camp at the Coruscating Mine, west of here. They're carting the ore off - and my tools with it, the thieving little louts.

Will you [get my tools back]? They'll be in the carts by the camp. Knock a few footpads over while you're there.
quests.summary: The siog took the lurikeen miners' camp at the Coruscating Mine. Brogan wants his tools back.

steps.goal: Kill 5 siog footpads round the ore carts, about 240 m west of Brogan
Search the ore carts (click the glinting spot)
steps.text: Brogan's tools, rolled in oilcloth. Under them, a lump of the mine's ore - and scratched into it, a little sign like a twist of wind. Not siog work.

steps.goal: Bring the tools to Brogan the Miner
steps.say:
My tools! And - what's this on the ore? That's no mark of ours. Somebody's marking the ore for themselves.

The siog don't keep anything. They sell it. Somebody is buying our mine one cart at a time.

default.text: From the Coruscating Mine, with thanks.

quests.title: The Glamoured Miner
quests.offer:
Cucugar - my partner - is still up at the mine. Working for them. Digging for the siog with a glazed look and a ring on his finger I've never seen before.

That's glamour. Will you [bring Cucugar back]? Knock the pillers off him first. Then knock some sense into him. Gently.
quests.summary: Brogan's partner Cucugar digs for the siog under a glamour.

steps.goal: Kill 4 siog pillers at the mine mouth, about 150 m north-west of Brogan
Subdue Miner Cucugar near the siog camp
steps.text: Cucugar sits down hard. The ring slides off his finger and the glaze goes out of his eyes. 'Brogan? Is it Tuesday? Why am I so TIRED?'

steps.goal: Bring Cucugar's ring to Brogan
steps.say:
He's sleeping it off in my tent, the great lump. Thank you.

That ring isn't siog-made. Siog can't do glamours that strong. Somebody gave it to them.

default.text: Take this, from both of us.

quests.title: Where the Ore Goes
quests.offer:
The siog have a fence at their camp - a big one, with a ledger. If anyone knows who's buying our ore, it's him.

Will you [find the buyer]? The Rangers at Druim Cain will want to know too. Commander Fearghal's been asking.
quests.summary: A siog fence at the camp below the mine knows who buys the stolen ore.

steps.goal: Defeat the siog fence at the siog camp, about 190 m south-west of Brogan
Search the fence's ledger at the siog camp (click the glinting spot)
steps.text: In a careful siog hand: 'Ore, twelve carts - to the druid at the stones, for wind-charms. Paid in charms.' The stones: the Druid Circle, east of here.

steps.goal: Go and look at the Druid Circle from its edge, about 200 m south-east of the siog camp
steps.text: Stones on a hill, and druids among them in cloaks of black feathers - and an ore cart, half-unloaded, at the foot of the circle.

steps.goal: Take the ledger to Ranger-Commander Fearghal at Druim Cain
steps.say:
Druids buying stolen ore for wind-charms. Wind-charms! In a valley where the wind's been wrong all year.

The Muintir in Caille will want this as much as I do. Good work. The Rangers won't forget it.

quests.title: Sloithi
quests.offer:
The siog have a chief - Sloithi - squatting in our camp like it's his. While he's there the camp is theirs.

Will you [throw Sloithi out]? Then I can decide whether we dig again or leave it be.
quests.summary: Sloithi, the siog chief, holds the miners' camp.

steps.goal: Defeat Sloithi at the siog camp
steps.text: Sloithi falls among his stolen pots. In his fist, a wind-charm - a twist of yew and scarlet thread - still humming.

steps.goal: Return to Brogan the Miner
steps.say:
Sloithi's out. Thank you.

We can [dig again] - the mine's rich, and the Rangers have promised a guard. Or we [let it rest]. The hill's been singing at night since the siog came. My granny would've said that's the hill telling us to stop.

options.say: Dig again, then. Picks up, lads! And somebody keep an eye on the hill.
Rest, then. We'll go and dig in Lough Derg like ordinary people. Bah.

dig.text: From the Coruscating Mine - the first ore of the new seam.

rest.text: From the Coruscating Mine, closed with thanks.

quests.title: The Dying Grove
quests.offer:
Our sacred grove in the western woods is dying. In midsummer, the leaves brown and the bark weeps.

Go and look at the [heart-hollow] in the old oak. Something's wrong there, and my legs won't carry me down that far any more.
quests.summary: Druid Ennis's sacred grove in the western woods is dying in midsummer.

steps.goal: Go to the sacred grove in the western woods, about 1 km south-west of Druim Cain
steps.text: Old oaks, brown in midsummer. The grass round them is grey. Moss sheeries pick at the roots.

steps.goal: Drive off 5 moss sheeries gnawing the grove's roots
Search the heart-hollow of the oldest oak (click the glinting spot)
steps.text: The hollow where the oak-heart lay is empty. Little three-toed prints all round it - siog - and a smell of black feathers.

steps.goal: Return to Druid Ennis at Druim Cain
steps.say:
Empty. Gods. The oak-heart is gone.

Siog prints and black feathers. The siog steal. Druids in black feathers... I know who wears black feathers. I'll have to ask you to go after it.

default.text: From the grove, while it lives.

quests.title: The Oak-Heart
quests.offer:
The grove's oak-heart has been stolen - a golden acorn that holds the life of every oak in our sacred grove. Without it they'll die by midwinter.

The siog took it. Siog take everything. But siog don't keep things - they sell them. Find their camp below the Coruscating Mine and you'll find who they sold it to. Will you [find the oak-heart]?
quests.summary: The siog stole the golden oak-heart that keeps a sacred grove alive, and sold it on.

steps.goal: Find the siog camp below the Coruscating Mine, about 700 m south-west of Druim Cain
steps.text: A camp of stolen things - pots, boots, a church bell, a chicken. Siog everywhere, counting.

steps.goal: Fight through 5 siog footpads at the camp
Search the siog's stolen goods (click the glinting spot)
steps.text: In a careful siog hand: 'One golden acorn. Sold to the druids at the stones. Paid: two wind-charms, one goat.' The stones - the Druid Circle, east.

steps.goal: Fight 4 renegade druids at the Druid Circle
Defeat the renegade archdruid
steps.text: The archdruid falls. A young druid in green kneels by the stones, holding the golden acorn, weeping.

stages.name: Archdruid Ruadh
stages.announce: A druid in a cloak of black feathers raises a staff of thorn. 'The grove is ours to move. Ennis is old and blind - and Riocard pays better.'

steps.goal: Talk to the young druid
steps.say:
I'm Aoibheann. Ennis' apprentice. I - I helped them. I told them where the oak-heart was kept.

Ruadh said the old grove was dying anyway and we could plant a new one, away from the keeps and the wars. Riocard promised. I believed them. Take it. Take it back to Ennis. And tell him I'm [sorry].

steps.goal: Return the oak-heart to Druid Ennis
steps.say:
The oak-heart! The grove will live!

...Aoibheann. My Aoibheann helped them.

The druids' law says an apprentice who betrays the grove is [turned out] - cast from the order, forever. Or I could [spare her], and take her back, and watch her every day. She was the best apprentice I ever had. That's why it hurts.

options.say: Then she'll come home, and plant the oak-heart with her own hands, and tend the grove until it forgives her. And I'll forgive her sooner.
...Then she's no druid. I'll tell her myself. It's the law, and the law is older than my heart.

quests.title: The Replanting
quests.offer:
The oak-heart must go back into the old oak tonight, with a druid singing over it. Riocard's thorn-hounds will smell it.

Will you [guard the planting]? Whoever sings it - Aoibheann or me - needs someone between them and the teeth.
quests.summary: The oak-heart goes back into the sacred grove, and Riocard's thorn-hounds will come for it.

steps.goal: Guard the planting in the sacred grove
steps.text: The singing ends. The oak sighs - you hear it - and a green flush runs up its bark into the brown leaves.

stages.name: Keep the grove-singer safe
stages.announce: The singer kneels at the old oak and begins. Out of the woods come thorn-bound hounds, baying.

steps.goal: Return to Druid Ennis at Druim Cain
steps.say:
I felt it from here. The grove breathed.

Thank you. Now - Riocard. A druid of the stones, paying siog in wind-charms. There's something under this, and it's cold.

quests.title: Ruadh's Letters
quests.offer:
Ruadh kept a satchel. If he wrote to Riocard, the letters will be at the Circle still.

Will you [fetch the satchel]? Then take what you find to Sarnat in Caille. If this is what I think it is, it's the Muintir's business more than mine.
quests.summary: Archdruid Ruadh's satchel, left at the Druid Circle, may say what Riocard wants.

steps.goal: Kill 4 renegade druids at the Druid Circle
Search for Ruadh's satchel at the Druid Circle (click the glinting spot)
steps.text: Letters, in Riocard's hand: 'The Lady of the Wind will have her rival. The ore buys the charms; the charms raise the wind; the wind finds the girl. The Queen in the forest keeps her word.' Signed with a twist of wind.

steps.goal: Take Ruadh's letters to Sarnat of Caille
steps.say:
'The Lady of the Wind will have her rival.'

Gods. Fuamnach. Midir's first wife - the one who turned Etain into a fly and blew her across Ireland. And 'the girl'.

If Fuamnach has woken, then somewhere in this valley Etain has been born again. And the Queen in the Cursed Forest is helping her. Thank you. I have a great deal to do.

default.text: From the Muintir, with my thanks.

quests.title: Beyond the Veil
quests.offer:
My grandson Rian went through the veil at Samhain. The veil wisps lit the way and he followed them into the Otherworld, laughing.

It's thin there still, in the west of the valley. The druids say a strong arm could reach through and pull him back. Will you [bring Rian home]? He's ten. He's always been ten, there.
quests.summary: Grandmother Muirenn's grandson followed the veil wisps into the Otherworld at Samhain.

steps.goal: Go to the thin place in the west of the valley, about 940 m south-west of Druim Cain
steps.text: Lights drift through the air - veil wisps - and between them, now and then, a glimpse of somewhere else: golden, endless, singing.

steps.goal: Scatter 5 veil wisps at the thin place
steps.text: As they go out, the glimpses of the Otherworld get clearer.

steps.goal: Search the edge of the veil (click the glinting spot)
steps.text: Rian's shoe. Half of it is here, and half of it is somewhere else, and it is very hard to look at.

steps.goal: Break 2 empyrean orbs that hold the veil open
Defeat the Keeper of the Veil
steps.text: The keeper unravels into light. The veil tears open for a moment, and a small boy tumbles out of it into the grass.

stages.name: Keeper of the Veil
stages.objective: Defeat the Keeper of the Veil
stages.announce: A tall shape of pale light stands between you and the gap. 'What passes the veil stays. That is the rule.'

steps.goal: Talk to Rian
steps.say:
Is it time to go home? I was only gone a day. Wasn't I?

I ate some apples. They were very good. The lady said if I ate them I'd have to [stay], but I could visit. And the riders kept asking me if I'd seen a lady with red hair. I hadn't.

steps.goal: Bring Rian home to Muirenn at Druim Cain
steps.say:
Rian! Rian - you're - oh.

He's ten. Still ten. And he ate their fruit. The druids say if he crosses back for good, every year he spent there catches up with him by morning. He'll wake up seventeen. His childhood gone in a night.

Or he can [go back], and stay ten forever, and visit me at Samhain. I can't choose. [Bring him back], or let him go.

options.say: Then he'll be seventeen tomorrow. And he'll be here. I'll teach him what he missed. ...I'll teach him fast.
Go on, my love. Go back to your apples. Come and see me at Samhain. I'll keep a candle in the window.

home.text: Take this. It won't fit him tomorrow.

quests.title: The Host Is Searching
quests.offer:
Fairy horses came through my pasture last night - right through the fence - and the riders on them looked into every byre and under every cart. Searching.

Will you [follow them]? Knock a few of the horses off my grass, and see where the riders go. And what they're looking for.
quests.summary: Midir's host is riding through the pastures, searching every byre.

steps.goal: Drive off 5 faerie horses on Tuathal's grazing, about 160 m south of Tuathal
Search the trampled fence for sign of the riders (click the glinting spot)

clue.name: a scarlet thread on a fence-nail

steps.text: A scarlet thread, caught on a nail - from a rider's sleeve. Every rider of the host wears a scarlet thread. Like a sign. Like mourning.

steps.goal: Watch the riders' camp from cover, about 120 m east
steps.text: Riders in green and gold round a fire that burns without smoke. One says it plainly, in the old tongue: 'She is in the valley again. The fly has come home. Find her before the wind does.'

steps.goal: Return to Herder Tuathal
steps.say:
'The fly has come home'? ...That's the old story. Etain, that Midir loved, turned into a scarlet fly.

They think she's here. In Bri Leith. Gods help whoever she is.

default.text: From my pasture, what's left of it.

quests.title: Midir's Rider
quests.offer:
The riders of Bri Leith carry messages between them in hollow rings. Take one, and we'll know what they know.

Will you [take a rider's ring]? Mind - they don't go down easy, and they don't ride alone. Then take what you find to Sarnat in Caille; she reads their tongue.
quests.summary: Midir's riders carry messages in hollow rings.

steps.goal: Defeat 2 riders of Bri Leith at their camp, about 200 m south-east of Tuathal
steps.text: The last rider falls with a sound like a harp-string breaking. A hollow ring rolls out of his glove.

steps.goal: Take the hollow ring to Sarnat of Caille
steps.say:
'Seek her where the scarlet fly rests. The wind is rising - Fuamnach is awake.'

So Midir knows too. His host isn't hunting her. It's trying to find her first.

quests.title: The Blademaster
quests.offer:
There's a man rides with the host - a mortal, a blademaster, carried off twenty years ago at a fair. My father knew him. He fights for them now and doesn't know his own name.

Will you [bring him round]? Beat him, and the host's hold on him might break. Mind Mikka, their champion - he's never far off.
quests.summary: A mortal blademaster, carried off by Midir's host twenty years ago, rides with them still.

steps.goal: Defeat The Blademaster on the pastures, about 110 m south-east of Tuathal - stay clear of Mikka
steps.text: The Blademaster lowers his sword and looks at his hands. 'Twenty years? It was a day. One dance. ...Tell my mother I'm sorry. No - she'll be dead. Gods.'

steps.goal: Return to Herder Tuathal
steps.say:
He knew you? He spoke? Then he's free, or near enough.

He'll go back to them, mind. Twenty years in that saddle - there's nothing for him here now. But he'll go back knowing his own name. That's something.

default.text: From my father's old friend - he left this for whoever freed him.

quests.title: Aideen's Dreams
quests.offer:
My Aideen dreams of a golden hall under a hill, and a lake with the moon in it, and a man with yellow hair who calls her by another name. Every night.

Sarnat in Caille says it's nothing. Sarnat looked very pale when she said it. Will you [talk to Aideen]? She'll tell a stranger more than her mother.
quests.summary: Nessa's daughter Aideen dreams every night of a golden hall under a hill.

steps.goal: Talk to Aideen in Brynach
steps.say: The lake's the one past the pastures - Moon Lake. I've never been. But I know there's a [stone] on the shore with a hole in it, and I used to sit in the hole. I KNOW that. How do I know that?

steps.goal: Go to the shore of Moon Lake, about 540 m south-east of Brynach
steps.text: A grey stone on the shore, with a hole worn through it - exactly a girl's size. The moon is on the water just as she said.

steps.goal: Search the holed stone on the shore (click the glinting spot)
steps.text: In the hollow of the stone, a single scarlet scale off an insect's wing - much bigger than any insect's. It's warm as a hand.

steps.goal: Take the wing-scale to Sarnat of Caille
steps.say:
Scarlet. Warm.

It's her. Aideen - it's Etain's own name, in the old tongue. Etain, born a third time, in Brynach of all places, to a weaver.

And Fuamnach's wind is rising. Don't tell Nessa. Not yet.

default.text: From the Muintir. And keep this between us.

quests.title: Where the Fly Rests
quests.offer:
There's a scarlet fly on the lake menhir, every night this month. A fly the size of a sparrow. And every night a cold wind comes down off the Heights hunting along the shore, and the wrath sprites go mad in it.

Will you [keep the sprites off] the menhir tonight? I don't know what that fly is. I know it's frightened.
quests.summary: A scarlet fly shelters on Moon Lake's menhir each night while a cold wind hunts the shore.

steps.goal: Kill 5 wrath sprites by the lake menhir, about 140 m north-east of Fisher Caoimhe
Stand by the menhir as the wind comes
steps.text: The wind comes down off the Heights out of a clear sky and goes along the shore like a hand searching. It passes over the menhir - and passes on. On the stone, a scarlet fly folds its wings.

steps.goal: Return to Fisher Caoimhe
steps.say:
It missed her. The wind missed her. ...Her? Why did I say her?

The Muintir would want to know of this. Sarnat in Caille.

quests.title: Fair Swap
quests.offer:
Last night something came to Aideen's bed and tried to put something else in it. Something that looked like her. I screamed and it ran - east, to the Hollow past the lake where the mad changelings live.

They want her. They'll come back. Will you [go to the Hollow] and make them stop?
quests.summary: The mad changelings tried to swap Aideen for one of their own.

steps.goal: Kill 6 mad changelings at the changeling den, about 950 m east of Brynach
Defeat Lusmorebane, king of the Hollow
steps.text: Lusmorebane cackles as he falls. 'Paid for! The Lady of the Wind paid for her! Blow her away, blow her away...'

steps.goal: Search the changelings' cradle in the den (click the glinting spot)

clue.name: a scarlet ribbon in the cradle

steps.text: In a cradle of thorns: a doll made to look exactly like Aideen, and tied round its neck, one of Aideen's own scarlet ribbons.

steps.goal: Return to Nessa the Weaver in Brynach
steps.say:
Her ribbon. They had her ribbon.

'The Lady of the Wind paid for her.' What lady? What wind? Why my daughter?

...Sarnat knows. I can see it on her. Go and ask her. Make her tell you.

default.text: Take this. From both of us - she wanted you to have the bracer.

quests.title: Riocard's Binding
quests.offer:
Riocard has bound Aideen somehow - a binding so the wind can find her wherever she runs. That's how Bresal did it in the old tale, for Fuamnach the first time.

It'll be at the Circle, in a binding-stone. Bring friends. Will you [break the binding]?
quests.summary: Riocard, the renegade druid at the Circle, has bound Aideen so Fuamnach's wind can find her.

steps.goal: Kill 6 renegade druids at the Druid Circle
Defeat Riocard, the renegade druid
steps.text: Riocard falls among his stones. 'The Queen promised her... the Queen promised ME... a seat in the forest court...'

steps.goal: Search the binding-stone in the middle of the Circle (click the glinting spot)

clue.name: a yew wand bound in scarlet

steps.text: A yew wand, bound with scarlet thread, set upright in a hole in the stone. It's ice-cold, and it points - always - toward Brynach.

steps.goal: Bring the yew wand to Sarnat of Caille
steps.say:
The binding. Gods, it's still pointing at her.

We can [break the wand] - and the wind loses her, for good. Or we [keep the wand], bound as it is, and use it: it points to her for Fuamnach, but it can point Fuamnach to US. We'd know where she'll come. It's a terrible risk.

options.say: Broken. Feel that? The air's warmer already. She's safe from the wind, at least.
Kept, then. Wrapped in rowan, in my strongbox. When Fuamnach comes, we'll know. Gods help us if we're wrong.

quests.title: The Hall Under the Hill
quests.offer:
Sarnat told me. Everything. I'm Etain - I was. A thousand years ago, and another life after that.

The riders came last night, to the edge of Brynach, and waited. They want me to come home - to Midir, under the hill. Mam wants me to stay. Will you [walk with me] to the riders? I need to see them before I choose.
quests.summary: Aideen, Etain born again, must choose between Midir's hall under the hill and her mortal life.

steps.goal: Walk with Aideen to the riders' camp in the pastures, about 330 m south of Brynach
steps.text: The riders kneel as you come. The fire without smoke burns higher. One of them - yellow-haired, crowned - gets up, and Aideen's hand goes tight on your arm.

steps.goal: Talk to Aideen in Brynach
steps.say:
That was him. Midir. He looked at me like - like I'd been gone a day.

If I [go under the hill], I'm Etain, and I'm home, and Mam loses me. If I [stay in Brynach], I'm Aideen, and I weave, and I grow old, and he waits again. He's good at waiting. Tell me which.

options.say: Then I'll go. At midsummer, from the lake stone. I'll come back at Samhain to see Mam - that's allowed. ...Tell her I chose it. Don't let her think I was taken.
Then I'm Aideen. I'll weave. And when I'm old, if he's still waiting, maybe. ...Thank you. Mam's going to cry either way.

hill.text: Take this. I made it for whoever helped me choose.

stay.text: Take this. I made it for whoever helped me choose.

quests.title: Waylayers on the Road
quests.offer:
Siog waylayers are hitting carts on the Collory road between here and Caille, from the rocks west of the road. We've lost three carts and two rangers.

Will you [clear the rocks]? Then look round for my rangers' arrows - I want to know where they made their stand.
quests.summary: Siog waylayers are hitting carts on the Collory road from the rocks west of it.

steps.goal: Kill 6 siog waylayers at the rocks west of the Collory road, about 220 m south-west of Druim Cain
Search the ambush rocks for the rangers' last stand (click the glinting spot)
steps.text: A quiver of Druim Cain arrows, every one shot. Behind the rocks, a waylayer's purse - paid in wind-charms, like the ore.

steps.goal: Return to Ranger-Commander Fearghal at Druim Cain
steps.say:
Every arrow shot. They died well.

Wind-charms again. The same coin as the ore. Somebody's paying for this whole valley in wind.

quests.title: Horns at the Tower
quests.offer:
The Wild Hunt's horns are sounding round Giolladhe's Tower every night, and the rage wolves run with them. They're marking the tower for something.

Will you [thin the wolves]? Then come back to me. If they're marking us, I want to know what for.
quests.summary: The Wild Hunt's horns sound round Giolladhe's Tower, and the rage wolves run with them.

steps.goal: Kill 3 rage wolves at their run, about 260 m south-east of the tower
Kill 4 faerie steeds near the run
Return to Watch-Sergeant Maudalin at Giolladhe's Tower
steps.say:
Fewer wolves. Good. And I found this while you were out: a horn-sign cut in the tower door. Riders' sign, Midir's - 'Not here. Search east.'

So the Hunt isn't after the tower. It's searching. Same as everyone this year.

quests.title: The Host's Champion
quests.offer:
Mikka. The host's champion. He rides the pastures south of here and he's put eleven rangers in the ground this year alone - for sport, between searches.

This is GROUP work. Will you [put Mikka down]? Not for good - he's sidhe, he'll be back. But long enough that the road breathes.
quests.summary: Mikka, champion of Midir's host, kills rangers on the pastures for sport.

steps.goal: Defeat Mikka, the host's champion, on the pastures, about 560 m east of the tower
steps.text: Mikka falls laughing. 'Well struck, mortal. Tell your Rangers - the host is not their enemy this year. The wind is. Look east.'

steps.goal: Report to Ranger-Commander Fearghal at Druim Cain
steps.say:
Mikka down! Eleven rangers, and you put him in the grass.

'The wind is. Look east.' East is the Cursed Forest. Ronan's scouts say the border's thick with the Queen's people. I don't like any of this.

default.text: From the Rangers - and eleven of them who'd thank you.

quests.title: The Road East
quests.offer:
Scout Fionnuala is down on the east border, where the old road went into the Cursed Forest. It's been shut for years - the Queen's people hold the gate stones.

Will you [go to Fionnuala] and see how thick they are? If we're going to open that gate, I need to know what it costs.
quests.summary: Ranger-Commander Fearghal wants to know what it would take to open the Forest Gate on the Cursed Forest border.

steps.goal: Find Ranger-Scout Fionnuala on the east border
steps.say:
You came the long way. Good - the short way's through them.

Look: black wraiths among the stones, poachers who never come back to their villages, and the far dorocha watching. Thin them, and I'll see what moves. [Ready]?

steps.goal: Kill 4 black wraiths among the gate stones, about 120 m east of Fionnuala
Report to Ranger-Commander Fearghal at Druim Cain
steps.say:
Wraiths, poachers and the Dark Man watching. A war band could do it - four at least, and a druid to wake a ward.

We'll muster when the valley's ready. When the Rangers' resolve is up, we go. Thank you.

quests.title: Wind off the Heights
quests.offer:
The wind comes off the Empyrean Heights, north-east. The empyreans live up there - the sky's own children, Keeper Rasa used to say. Rasa hasn't come down to Caille in a month.

Will you [go up the Heights] and see? Carefully. The empyreans used to be gentle.
quests.summary: Fuamnach's wind comes off the Empyrean Heights, and Keeper Rasa hasn't been seen in a month.

steps.goal: Kill 6 empyrean sentinels on the lower Heights, about 350 m east of Caille
Search the guardian stones on the Heights (click the glinting spot)
steps.text: Frost on the stone in midsummer, carved by the wind itself: a long, cruel F. And the wind round the stones comes, very clearly, from the east - from the Cursed Forest.

steps.goal: Return to Sarnat of Caille
steps.say:
F. Fuamnach signs her wind.

And it blows out of the Cursed Forest. The Queen has taken her in, then. Rasa - find Rasa. Her hut is high on the Heights. If anyone can turn the empyreans back, she can.

quests.title: The Keeper's Hut
quests.offer:
Rasa's hut is high on the Heights, north-east. If the empyreans have turned, she's trapped up there with them.

Will you [find Rasa]? Bring friends - the Heights are hard going.
quests.summary: Keeper Rasa is trapped in her hut on the Heights by the empyreans she kept.

steps.goal: Climb to Keeper Rasa's hut on the Empyrean Heights, about 570 m north-east of Caille
steps.text: A small stone hut, its door barred from inside. Empyrean keepers circle it like hawks - and from inside, a woman's voice, hoarse, singing.

steps.goal: Kill 5 empyrean keepers circling the hut
Talk to Keeper Rasa in her hut
steps.say:
You came. A month I've sung at the door to keep them out. My own empyreans. The sky's children.

It's not them. It's the wind that's in them - her wind, Fuamnach's, blowing out of the Queen's forest. I can turn them back, one by one, if you break her lieutenants. Stay a while. I'll tell you how.

default.text: Take these. I've had a month to sort my things.

quests.title: Guardian Hru
quests.offer:
Hru was the gentlest of my guardians. Now he holds the guardian stones for her, south of here, and the wind blows through him like a flute.

Will you [break Hru's hold]? Beat him down, and I'll sing the wind out of him from here.
quests.summary: Guardian Hru holds the guardian stones for Fuamnach.

steps.goal: Defeat Guardian Hru at the guardian stones, about 520 m south of Rasa's hut
steps.text: Hru goes down, and up on the Heights you hear Rasa singing. The wind goes out of him with a sigh, and he stands, blinking, gentle.

steps.goal: Return to Keeper Rasa
steps.say:
I felt him come back. Thank you.

Niy is next - and Niy is the strong one.

quests.title: Niy the Overseer
quests.offer:
Niy the Overseer holds the eastern ridge, the one that looks into the Cursed Forest. Her wind goes through him first.

This is GROUP work. Will you [break Niy]? While he stands, I can't reach the others.
quests.summary: Niy the Overseer holds the eastern ridge for Fuamnach.

steps.goal: Defeat Niy the Overseer on the eastern ridge, about 230 m east of Rasa's hut
steps.text: Niy falls on the ridge. Beyond it, the Cursed Forest is black to the horizon - and above the Heights, the wind howls a woman's name: hers.

steps.goal: Return to Keeper Rasa
steps.say:
Niy's free. Now she's alone up there, at the Eye of the Wind, on the highest point of the Heights.

She'll know you're coming. She'll want you to come.

quests.title: Fuamnach
quests.offer:
Fuamnach is at the Eye of the Wind, the highest point of the Heights, north-east of here. Twice she drove Etain out. She will not do it a third time.

This is GROUP work - the hardest in the valley. Bring the best you know. Will you [face Fuamnach]?
quests.summary: Fuamnach, Midir's jealous first wife, waits at the Eye of the Wind on the highest point of the Heights.

steps.goal: Climb to the Eye of the Wind, about 270 m north-east of Rasa's hut
steps.text: A ring of stones on the summit, and in it a woman in grey with a rowan rod, the wind pouring off her toward Brynach. 'Again?' she says. 'Every time, someone. And every time, the Queen will lend me another wind.'

steps.goal: Defeat Fuamnach at the Eye of the Wind
steps.text: Fuamnach falls, and the wind falls with her - all of it, all at once, so the silence rings. Far east, over the Cursed Forest, something laughs.

steps.goal: Return to Keeper Rasa
steps.say:
It's still. The whole valley's still.

She'll come back - she always comes back, while the Queen lends her wind. I can [scatter her] to the four winds, so it takes her a thousand years to gather herself again. Or I can [bind her] here, in the stones of the Eye, where I can watch her. Watched, she can't hide in the Queen's forest. Scattered, she can't hurt Aideen.

options.say: Scattered, then. A thousand years. Aideen will be dust - happy, I hope - before she's whole again.
Bound, then. I'll sit with her. Someone has to. And if the Queen comes for her, we'll know.

scatter.text: Take these. From the Heights, the Muintir, and a girl in Brynach who'll never know your name.

bind.text: Take these. From the Heights, the Muintir, and a girl in Brynach who'll never know your name.
